entities.name: Festival of the Arena
entities.description: Yearly festival in Estark, Kush, where wizards of the five Houses fought magical duels.

entities.name: Estark
entities.description: City in Kush where the Festival was held.

entities.name: Kush
entities.description: Land in the Domains with five Houses.

entities.name: Kuthuman
entities.description: Ruler under whom the arena was built; secretly euthanized each Festival winner and ascended after the Night of Fire.

entities.name: Zarel Ewine
entities.description: Led the Night of Fire massacre and became Grand Master.

entities.name: House Oor-tael
entities.description: House massacred on the Night of Fire.

entities.name: Night of Fire
entities.description: Massacre of House Oor-tael on the last evening of the 978th Festival.

entities.name: Garth One-eye
entities.description: Returned during the 998th Festival to take revenge for the Night of Fire and won that Festival.

entities.name: Time of Troubles
entities.description: Garth One-eye's actions during the 998th Festival.

entities.name: Walker
entities.description: Figure who traveled with the winner and in reality killed him.

events.summary: The Night of Fire: Zarel Ewine leads a massacre of House Oor-tael, joined by the other four houses.
events.quote: Zarel Ewine led a massacre of the House Oor-tael

events.summary: Kuthuman capitalizes on the massacre to ascend and Zarel becomes Grand Master.
events.quote: Zarel became the new Grand Master

events.summary: Zarel Ewine allows fighters to declare deathmatches in the 998th Festival.
events.quote: fighters in this and subsequent rounds could unilaterally declare their fight a deathmatch

events.summary: Garth One-eye returns during the 998th Festival to take revenge for the Night of Fire, starting the Time of Troubles.
events.quote: Garth One-eye returned to the city to take his revenge for the Night of Fire

events.summary: Garth One-Eye wins the 998th Festival, with Varena of Fentesk second.
events.quote: Garth One-Eye was the victor, with Varena of Fentesk in second

relations.quote: Zarel became the new Grand Master
